post_login_url.label: Redirect URL
post_login_url.description: The URL of the 'page not found' page you reached after signing in on Audible.

intro.label: Pick your Audible marketplace and continue. You will be sent to Amazon to sign in; after signing in you land on a 'page not found' page (that is expected) whose URL you paste back here on the next step.

authorize.label: Open the Audible sign-in page with the link icon and log in. You then reach a 'page not found' page - copy its full URL from the address bar, paste it below and continue.

authenticate.title: Sign in to Audible
authenticate.description: Open the sign-in page, log in, then paste the resulting redirect URL.

manifest.description: Access Audible's extensive audiobook library and podcast catalogue — perfect for spoken-word listening.
